findings.evidence: Lines 93-94, 114-115 carry the denominators; lines 120-121, 127-128, 138-139, 145-151, 182-184, 191-195 each re-establish `g F.n F.n = 1` and/or `≠ 0` to remove them.
findings.fix: Add the normal-form lemmas `@[simp] theorem energy_apply' (p) : F.energy p = g p F.n` and `@[simp] theorem spatial_apply' (p) : F.spatial p = p - g p F.n • F.n`, proved once from `F.norm`, and prove the downstream results from those; `bilin_spatial_spatial` and `one_sub_cosAngle_of_massless` then need `ring`/`field_simp [hEa.ne', hEb.ne']` only on genuine denominators.
findings.issue: `norm : g n n = 1` (line 80) makes the `/ Real.sqrt (g F.n F.n)` in `energy_apply` and the `/ g F.n F.n` in `spatial_apply` (line 114) always division by `1`, so every later proof must clear them: `simp only [hnE, Real.sqrt_one, div_one]` (121), `field_simp; ring` (194-195, 256-257), and the awkward double division in the statement of `energy_div_smul_add_spatial` (119). The `field_simp` steps additionally depend on `Real.sqrt 1` being collapsed by the ambient default simp set inside `field_simp`, which is exactly the short-but-brittle pattern.

findings.evidence: Lines 127-128, 138-139, 144-151, 191 all derive the same two facts from `F.norm`.
findings.fix: State it once, e.g. `@[simp] theorem bilin_n_ne_zero : g F.n F.n ≠ 0 := by rw [F.norm]; norm_num` (and `F.n ≠ 0`, needed at 144-148), and reuse it.
findings.issue: The fact `g F.n F.n ≠ 0` is re-proved inline five times (`hn0` 128, `h1` 139, `hN` 149-151, implicitly 182-184, `hone` 191), each time by `rw [F.norm]; norm_num`.

findings.evidence: Lines 181-185: the only use of the norm in that branch is `F.norm` inside `simpa` on line 184.
findings.fix: Delete line 182; drop `gWit_apply` from the `open` list on line 267.
findings.issue: `have hn : g F.n F.n = 1 := F.norm` is never used in the branch: the following `have hp'` goes through `simpa [F.norm] using hp 1`. Same class of dead reference at line 267, where `gWit_apply` is named in the `open` but never used (it is `@[simp]`, so it applies regardless).

findings.evidence: Lines 200-204 and 221-226: the right-hand sides are the literal definition bodies.
findings.fix: Close both with `rfl`, or drop the lemmas and use the defining equations directly (`cosAngle_comm`, `cosAngle_self` already `rw [cosAngle]`).
findings.issue: `spatialNorm_def` (203) and `cosAngle_def` (224) restate their definitions verbatim and are closed by `simp [spatialNorm]` / `simp [cosAngle]`, hiding that the goals are `rfl` and making the proof depend on the simp set rather than on unfolding.

summary: Six proofs re-derive the same `g n n = 1` / `≠ 0` boilerplate because `energy_apply` and `spatial_apply` keep denominators that the structure field forces to `1`, and each downstream proof has to dispose of them (`Real.sqrt_one`, `div_one`, `field_simp`). Also a dead `have` and two definition-restating lemmas closed by `simp` instead of `rfl`.
